title: Sensor Message Bus: std::variant + std::visit
hints: stampOf: every alternative has `.stamp`, so one generic lambda works: `std::visit([](const auto& m) { return m.stamp; }, msg)`.

process: one visit with `[&](const auto& m) { using T = std::decay_t<decltype(m)>; if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, LidarMsg>) {...} else if constexpr ... }`. Keep `std::optional<double> last_imu_stamp` for the integration.
sortByStamp: `std::stable_sort(msgs.begin(), msgs.end(), [](const Msg& a, const Msg& b) { return stampOf(a) < stampOf(b); });` (stable keeps arrival order for ties).
